svg.title: Mart models: the tables the results come from
svg.desc: Diagram of the seven dbt mart tables: fct_money_map, fct_payout_checks, the four fix tables and fct_fix_ranking, with their grain, keys and main columns.
svg.text: Mart models: the tables the results come from
Stored as tables. The money map and payout check describe 2025; the fix tables value each fix, and the ranking orders them.
WHERE THE MONEY GOES, AND WHAT THE BANKS OWE
Each side is summed per shop and month first, then joined.
Differences are reported − expected: a positive fee difference
means the bank took too much.
WHAT EACH FIX IS WORTH PER YEAR (ONE ROW PER SHOP)
reads int_payments, int_approved_payments, int_shop_margins, stg_banks, stg_fee_rules
reads the four fix tables (sums per fix, never added together)
the four fix tables, summed per fix
